actual_scope: Exact minima in F2[Q8], with three arbitrary dirty scalar roles, all rank-one idempotents in M3(F2), and paid labels x=i,y=j: six coordinate permutations of diag([z],[z],[x]) or diag([z],[z],[y]), plus diag([z],[z],[z]), where z=-1=x^2=y^2. Equality is coefficientwise in the full eight-element group algebra.
scope_change_reason: The card permits a specified nonabelian address group. This run refines the Q8 result to a different target-role profile: two central outputs and one order-four output, then answers the predecessor package open question for three central outputs. These targets differ from the earlier two-central-plus-identity and one-central-plus-two-order-four cases.
bottleneck_link: Exact local bit-call minima constrain this nonabelian call model. The result gives no selected-supplier mapping or local saving; the selected complex primitive remains binding, so there is no kappa change.
stop_rule: Complete coefficientwise BFS over all 56 factors through depth four; use the first-order trace parity to exclude the only remaining length for diag(z,z,z); stop at exact minima or a verified shorter witness. Do not extend to other groups, labels, roles, or lengths.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json records exact state-layer counts/digests and target minima; verify.py replays the exact BFS, checks Q8 and GL3 controls, generic transition comparisons, direct positive controls, and call-deletion controls.
